articles.storyTitle: The Angel did not have to tap
The Apes were ready, but the path was closed
A Bolt paid for, then countered
The creature they chose to lose
One land behind, three Plains ahead in hand
I kept two cards and paid four life
The new Elf could tap immediately
Passing once did not end the spell
The second attacker met the same Maze
